_doc: Coordinate overrides for registry-mispositioned plants in us_power_plants.json. Applied by scripts/build_powerplants.py AFTER the GPPD/EIA-860 coordinate choice, keyed by gppd_idnr, and ONLY while the registry coordinate still matches 'from' (within 0.02 deg) — if upstream fixes a position, the stale override self-disables instead of clobbering it. Method (position audit 2026-07-18, research/position_audit_2026-07-18.md): OSM Overpass cross-check found these plants >3km from any wind-tagged power feature while the named farm exists elsewhere in OSM; 'to' = centroid of the OSM power=plant relation's member nodes. OSM data timestamp 2026-07-18T01:28Z, ODbL.

overrides.name: Waverly Wind Farm LLC
overrides.evidence: Human-reported case (2026-07-17 screenshots). Registry point is empty farmland ~17km WSW of the farm: nearest OSM turbine node/3879070054 16.9km NE; OSM power=plant relation/13566614 'Waverly Wind Farm' (plant:source=wind) member-node centroid (95 nodes) = 'to'. Independent: GEM 'Waverly wind farm' (199MW) @ 38.3528,-95.557 is 24.9km from 'from', 3.1km from 'to'. GPPD v1.3.0 CSV carries the same wrong value (registry-chain error).

overrides.name: Waverly Community Wind Project
overrides.evidence: Registry point = owner's fossil-plant address: 0.46km from OSM 'South Power Plant' (plant:source=oil, operator Waverly Utilities) and identical to our 'Waverly Municipal Electric North Plant' (oil) record. Actual OSM relation/14151897 'Waverly Community Wind Project' 5.8km E; its turbine nodes 4.3-8.4km. 'to' = relation member-node centroid (3 nodes).

overrides.name: Scurry County Wind LP
overrides.evidence: No wind feature within 3km of registry point (turbines 4.6km SW belong to another farm); OSM power=plant relation/6903041 'Scurry County Wind' 14.7km ENE beside the Camp Springs Wind substations. 'to' = relation member-node centroid (87 nodes). Our separate 'Scurry County Wind II' record is ~2km from OSM's phase-II relation and needs no fix.

overrides.name: Anacacho Wind Farm  LLC
overrides.evidence: Nearest OSM turbines 4.4km S of registry point; OSM power=plant relation/4920626 'Anacacho Wind Farm' 5.5km SSE. 'to' = relation member-node centroid (55 nodes). Independent: GEM 'Anacacho wind farm' (99.8MW) @ 29.1832,-100.204 is 5.75km from 'from', 1.39km from 'to'.
